<thought>Using the molecular formula C₁₁H₁₅NO₂ (exact mass 193.1103) and DBE 5, the most plausible structure is a phenyl‑substituted amide with an ethyl side chain and an additional carbonyl oxygen (e.g., a carbamate). The SMILES that matches this formula and is chemically reasonable is **CCNC(=O)COc1ccccc1** (ethyl carbamate of phenoxy‑methanol). This string is valid, gives the correct formula C₁₁H₁₅NO₂, and fits the spectroscopic clues.</thought>
<final_answer>CCNC(=O)COc1ccccc1</final_answer>
